cell_type_or_model: αVβ6-expressing epithelial cells and lung fibrosis models
assay_or_perturbation: LAP/αVβ6 binding; latent TGFβ1 activation; integrin-deficient and fibrosis assays
evidence_summary: TGFβ1 LAP bound αVβ6 and αVβ6-expressing cells activated latent TGFβ1 in a spatially restricted manner.
limitations: This is latent-complex activation, not mature TGFβ1 binding; no terminal TF target was assigned.

assay_or_perturbation: FBN1/αVβ6 binding; latent TGFβ1 activation; matrix and integrin perturbation assays
evidence_summary: Matrix-integrin αVβ6 interactions were associated with activation of latent TGFβ1 and tissue-remodeling responses.
limitations: The exact matrix ligand contribution and terminal TF remain unresolved.

assay_or_perturbation: TGFB1-SDC2 binding/uptake; TGFBR trafficking and SMAD/matrix assays
evidence_summary: TGFB1-SDC2/betaglycan context was associated with TGFBR trafficking and SMAD/matrix responses.
limitations: This is a co-receptor/trafficking branch, not αVβ6-mediated latent-ligand activation.
